mapper.update: MERGE INTO T_JOURNAL_IMAGE t USING ( SELECT #{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR} AS TERM_GROUP_ID, #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TERM_ID, #{jnlDate,jdbcType=CHAR} AS JNL_DATE, #{jnlTime,jdbcType=CHAR} AS JNL_TIME, #{imageType,jdbcType=CHAR} AS IMAGE_TYPE FROM DUAL ) s ON ( t.TERM_GROUP_ID = s.TERM_GROUP_ID AND t.TERM_ID = s.TERM_ID AND t.JNL_DATE = s.JNL_DATE AND t.JNL_TIME = s.JNL_TIME AND t.IMAGE_TYPE = s.IMAGE_TYPE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.IMAGE_PATH = #{imagePath,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, JNL_DATE, JNL_TIME, IMAGE_TYPE, IMAGE_PATH ) VALUES ( #{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{jnlDate,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{jnlTime,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{imageType,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{imagePath,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
